identity.name: Registry — State and Statistics of All Honeycombs
identity.description: Central registry of the Mandala system. Contains current state of all honeycombs, statistics, health status, and change tracking. Detailed honeycomb data is sourced from individual manifests — this file stores only aggregated metrics.

meta.purpose: The registry is the single source of truth about the state of all honeycombs. It is updated automatically by honeycomb_scanner.py on every scan.
meta.lifecycle: The registry is updated automatically on every scan. Manual changes are only allowed through patch protocols.

backups.description: Backup copies of the registry before significant changes. Stored with timestamps.

core.description: Core registry files: current state, configuration, change log.

scan_state.description: Current state: last scan timestamp, honeycomb hashes, statistics, scanner config.

scanner_config.description: Scanner configuration: scanning logic, validation rules, update triggers.

change_log.description: Log of all changes in the registry (new, modified, deleted honeycombs).

dashboard.description: HTML dashboard for visualizing the state of honeycombs.

modules.description: Registry of modules — larger functional blocks composed of multiple honeycombs.

extensions.description: Registry of extensions — pluggable modules that extend core functionality.

notifications.description: Notification rules and templates for system events.

rules.read_on_start: External SR SHOULD read registry contents to understand the current state of the system.
rules.update_mechanism: The registry is updated automatically by honeycomb_scanner.py. Manual updates are made via patch protocols with mandatory pre-check.
rules.who_updates: Internal SR (engineer-chat) or External SR (via patch protocol). Gardener confirms critical changes.
rules.format: All registry files must be valid JSON with identity and content sections.

registry.source_of_truth: Individual honeycomb manifests (index.json in each honeycomb folder). This file stores only registry metadata and aggregated statistics.

health.notes: Lightweight v3.1.0. Removed content.registry.honeycombs (redundant — source of truth is individual manifests + scan_state.json). Clean UTF-8. English Core.
